# Objetivo

Este notebook inicia la etapa de modelamiento zonal del crecimiento QR entre
2024 y 2025. El EDA previo dejo definida la pregunta descriptiva: que zonas
crecen mas o menos que la tendencia general QR, que variables se alinean con
esas diferencias y que zonas explican mas volumen agregado.

El objetivo de este notebook no es probar causalidad. La meta es construir una
secuencia reproducible de modelos predictivo-descriptivos que permita:

1. establecer baselines simples;
2. medir cuanto agregan las familias de variables candidatas;
3. comparar lectura por tasa y lectura por volumen;
4. dejar una especificacion defendible para el manuscrito.

Se modelan dos geografias por separado:

- `Residencia`: tarjetas QR/BIP del ano asociadas a zona hogar;
- `Origen de viaje`: viajes iniciados en la zona.

La unidad de analisis es la zona `ZONA777`. Las variables territoriales no se
interpretan como atributos individuales de personas.

# 3.1) Preparacion minima para modelar

Las variables de soporte y volumen se mantienen en el panel original para
filtrar y ponderar. Para entrar como predictores lineales se crean versiones
logaritmicas.

```{python}
#| label: block0b-prepare-model-features
print("label: block0b-prepare-model-features")

def add_modeling_transforms(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df.empty:
        return df.copy()

    out = df.copy()
    for source_col in ["support_min", "n_2024", "n_2025"]:
        if source_col in out.columns:
            values = pd.to_numeric(out[source_col], errors="coerce")
            values = values.clip(lower=0)
            out[f"{source_col}_log"] = np.log1p(values)
    return out


model_df = add_modeling_transforms(model_df)

prepared_cols = [
    col
    for col in ["support_min_log", "n_2024_log", "n_2025_log"]
    if col in model_df.columns
]

print(f"prepared transformed columns: {prepared_cols}")
display(model_df[prepared_cols].describe().T if prepared_cols else pd.DataFrame())
```

# 4) Definicion de outcomes y pesos

Outcome principal:

```text
delta_relative_pp = delta zonal QR - delta global QR de la geografia
```

Este outcome responde la pregunta: que zonas crecieron mas o menos que la
tendencia general QR de su propia geografia.

Pesos candidatos:

- zonas pesan igual: pregunta territorial promedio;
- `support_min`: reduce ruido de zonas con bajo soporte;
- `n_2025`: aproxima importancia operacional/volumetrica.

# 4.1) Consideraciones antes de modelar

Hay dos cuidados metodologicos que se deben mantener durante toda la
comparacion de modelos.

Primero, las variables de soporte y volumen tienen colas fuertes. En modelos
lineales no deberian entrar crudas. La especificacion base debe usar
transformaciones tipo `log1p(support_min)` y `log1p(n_2025)`, ademas de
estandarizacion dentro del `Pipeline`. En modelos de arboles esto es menos
critico para el ajuste, pero sigue siendo util para mantener una lectura
comparable.

Segundo, `n_2025` solo es defendible en modelos descriptivos del crecimiento
observado entre 2024 y 2025. Si el objetivo se formula como prediccion estricta
de 2025 usando informacion previa, `n_2025` debe reemplazarse por volumen
pre-periodo, por ejemplo `n_2024` o soporte historico comparable.

La validacion por macrozona tambien debe leerse con cuidado. En `KFold` normal,
`macrozone_group` funciona como control territorial. En `GroupKFold` por
macrozona, en cambio, una macrozona completa queda fuera del entrenamiento, por
lo que el efecto fijo de esa macrozona no puede aprenderse ni transferirse de
forma directa. Por eso, `GroupKFold` debe reportarse como prueba exigente de
transferencia territorial. Si su desempeno cae mucho, la lectura no es
automaticamente que el modelo falla, sino que parte de la senal es territorial y
no extrapola limpiamente entre macrozonas.

# 6) Dataset analitico por geografia

Esta seccion filtra soporte, separa geografias y define columnas disponibles. La
primera ejecucion real debe revisar nombres de columnas contra el panel exportado
desde el EDA.

```{python}
#| label: block3-build-analysis-datasets
print("label: block3-build-analysis-datasets")

def available_features(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [col for col in candidates if col in df.columns]


def build_analysis_dataset(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    geography_key: str,
    outcome: str = PRIMARY_OUTCOME,
    min_support: int = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[str], list[str]]:
    if df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(), [], []

    base = df.loc[
        df["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
        & df["support_min"].ge(min_support)
        & df[outcome].notna()
    ].copy()

    if geography_key == "residence":
        families = ["base", "residence_socio", "urban_osm", "bip_access"]
    elif geography_key == "origin_trip":
        families = ["base", "origin_operations", "urban_osm", "bip_access"]
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"geography_key no reconocida: {geography_key}")

    feature_candidates = [
        feature
        for family in families
        for feature in FEATURE_FAMILIES[family]
    ]
    features = available_features(base, feature_candidates)
    categorical_features = [col for col in ["macrozone_group"] if col in features]
    numeric_features = [col for col in features if col not in categorical_features]
    return base, numeric_features, categorical_features


analysis_datasets = {}
for geography_key in GEOGRAPHIES:
    data, numeric_features, categorical_features = build_analysis_dataset(
        model_df,
        geography_key=geography_key,
    )
    analysis_datasets[geography_key] = {
        "data": data,
        "numeric_features": numeric_features,
        "categorical_features": categorical_features,
    }
    print(
        geography_key,
        f"rows={len(data)}",
        f"numeric={len(numeric_features)}",
        f"categorical={categorical_features}",
    )
```

# 8.2) Helpers modulares para pipelines y validacion

```{python}
#| label: block5c-baseline-modeling-helpers
print("label: block5c-baseline-modeling-helpers")

def make_one_hot_encoder() -> OneHotEncoder:
    try:
        return OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False)
    except TypeError:
        return OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse=False)


def make_estimator(estimator_name: str):
    if estimator_name == "DummyRegressor":
        return DummyRegressor(strategy="mean")
    if estimator_name == "LinearRegression":
        return LinearRegression()
    if estimator_name == "RidgeCV":
        return RidgeCV(alphas=np.logspace(-3, 3, 25))
    if estimator_name == "LassoCV":
        return LassoCV(
            alphas=np.logspace(-4, 1, 40),
            cv=5,
            random_state=SEED,
            max_iter=10000,
        )
    if estimator_name == "ElasticNetCV":
        return ElasticNetCV(
            alphas=np.logspace(-4, 1, 40),
            l1_ratio=[0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9],
            cv=5,
            random_state=SEED,
            max_iter=10000,
        )
    if estimator_name == "RandomForestRegressor":
        return RandomForestRegressor(
            n_estimators=500,
            max_depth=4,
            min_samples_leaf=20,
            max_features="sqrt",
            random_state=SEED,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
    if estimator_name == "XGBoostRegressor":
        try:
            from xgboost import XGBRegressor
        except ImportError as exc:
            raise ImportError(
                "xgboost no esta instalado en este entorno. "
                "Usa RandomForestRegressor o instala xgboost antes de correr este bloque."
            ) from exc
        return XGBRegressor(
            n_estimators=300,
            max_depth=2,
            learning_rate=0.03,
            subsample=0.8,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            objective="reg:squarederror",
            random_state=SEED,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
    raise ValueError(f"Estimador no soportado aun: {estimator_name}")


def make_regression_pipeline(
    *,
    numeric_features: list[str],
    categorical_features: list[str],
    estimator_name: str,
) -> Pipeline:
    estimator = make_estimator(estimator_name)
    if estimator_name == "DummyRegressor":
        return Pipeline([("estimator", estimator)])

    tree_estimators = {"RandomForestRegressor", "XGBoostRegressor"}
    transformers = []
    if numeric_features:
        numeric_steps = [("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median"))]
        if estimator_name not in tree_estimators:
            numeric_steps.append(("scaler", StandardScaler()))
        transformers.append(
            (
                "num",
                Pipeline(numeric_steps),
                numeric_features,
            )
        )
    if categorical_features:
        transformers.append(
            (
                "cat",
                Pipeline(
                    [
                        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
                        ("onehot", make_one_hot_encoder()),
                    ]
                ),
                categorical_features,
            )
        )

    if not transformers:
        raise ValueError("Modelo lineal sin predictores. Usa DummyRegressor.")

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers=transformers, remainder="drop")
    return Pipeline(
        [
            ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
            ("estimator", estimator),
        ]
    )


def prepare_spec_features(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    spec: dict,
    validation_plan: dict,
) -> dict:
    requested_features = list(spec["features"])
    requested_categorical = list(spec.get("categorical", []))
    dropped_for_validation = []

    if validation_plan.get("drop_group_predictor"):
        group_col = validation_plan.get("group_col")
        requested_features = [col for col in requested_features if col != group_col]
        requested_categorical = [col for col in requested_categorical if col != group_col]
        if group_col in spec["features"]:
            dropped_for_validation.append(group_col)

    missing_features = [col for col in requested_features if col not in data.columns]
    features = [col for col in requested_features if col in data.columns]
    categorical_features = [col for col in requested_categorical if col in features]
    numeric_features = [col for col in features if col not in categorical_features]

    return {
        "features": features,
        "numeric_features": numeric_features,
        "categorical_features": categorical_features,
        "missing_features": missing_features,
        "dropped_for_validation": dropped_for_validation,
    }


def normalized_sample_weight(data: pd.DataFrame, weight_col: str | None) -> np.ndarray | None:
    if weight_col is None:
        return None
    if weight_col not in data.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"No existe columna de peso: {weight_col}")

    weights = pd.to_numeric(data[weight_col], errors="coerce")
    valid = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    fallback = valid.loc[valid.gt(0)].median()
    if not np.isfinite(fallback):
        fallback = 1.0
    valid = valid.where(valid.gt(0), fallback).fillna(fallback)
    mean_weight = valid.mean()
    if not np.isfinite(mean_weight) or mean_weight <= 0:
        mean_weight = 1.0
    return (valid / mean_weight).to_numpy()


def iter_validation_splits(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    validation_plan: dict,
    *,
    n_splits: int = 5,
):
    if validation_plan["group_col"] is None:
        splitter = KFold(
            n_splits=min(n_splits, len(data)),
            shuffle=True,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        yield from splitter.split(data)
        return

    group_col = validation_plan["group_col"]
    if group_col not in data.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"No existe columna de grupo: {group_col}")

    groups = data[group_col].astype("string").fillna("Sin macrozona")
    n_groups = groups.nunique()
    if n_groups < 2:
        raise ValueError(f"No hay suficientes grupos para GroupKFold: {n_groups}")

    splitter = GroupKFold(n_splits=min(n_splits, n_groups))
    yield from splitter.split(data, groups=groups)


def evaluate_model_cv(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    spec: dict,
    validation_plan: dict,
    *,
    geography_key: str,
    outcome: str = PRIMARY_OUTCOME,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if data.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    model_data = data.loc[data[outcome].notna()].reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    feature_info = prepare_spec_features(model_data, spec, validation_plan)
    if feature_info["missing_features"]:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            [
                {
                    "geography_key": geography_key,
                    "geography": GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key),
                    "model_id": spec["model_id"],
                    "label": spec["label"],
                    "validation_id": validation_plan["validation_id"],
                    "validation": validation_plan["validation"],
                    "weighting": validation_plan["weighting"],
                    "status": "missing_features",
                    "missing_features": ", ".join(feature_info["missing_features"]),
                }
            ]
        )

    y = model_data[outcome].astype(float).to_numpy()
    X = (
        model_data[feature_info["features"]].copy()
        if feature_info["features"]
        else pd.DataFrame(index=model_data.index)
    )
    sample_weight = normalized_sample_weight(model_data, validation_plan["weight_col"])
    pipeline = make_regression_pipeline(
        numeric_features=feature_info["numeric_features"],
        categorical_features=feature_info["categorical_features"],
        estimator_name=spec["estimator"],
    )

    rows = []
    for fold_id, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
        iter_validation_splits(model_data, validation_plan),
        start=1,
    ):
        fitted = clone(pipeline)
        fit_kwargs = {}
        if sample_weight is not None:
            fit_kwargs["estimator__sample_weight"] = sample_weight[train_idx]
        fitted.fit(X.iloc[train_idx], y[train_idx], **fit_kwargs)

        y_pred = fitted.predict(X.iloc[test_idx])
        test_weight = sample_weight[test_idx] if sample_weight is not None else None

        mse = mean_squared_error(y[test_idx], y_pred, sample_weight=test_weight)
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography_key": geography_key,
                "geography": GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key),
                "model_id": spec["model_id"],
                "label": spec["label"],
                "validation_id": validation_plan["validation_id"],
                "validation": validation_plan["validation"],
                "weighting": validation_plan["weighting"],
                "outcome": outcome,
                "fold": fold_id,
                "fold_n": len(test_idx),
                "fold_weight_sum": (
                    float(np.sum(test_weight)) if test_weight is not None else float(len(test_idx))
                ),
                "r2": r2_score(y[test_idx], y_pred, sample_weight=test_weight),
                "rmse_pp": float(np.sqrt(mse)),
                "mae_pp": mean_absolute_error(y[test_idx], y_pred, sample_weight=test_weight),
                "features_used": ", ".join(feature_info["features"]),
                "categorical_used": ", ".join(feature_info["categorical_features"]),
                "features_dropped_for_validation": ", ".join(feature_info["dropped_for_validation"]),
                "missing_features": "",
                "status": "ok",
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def summarize_cv_results(fold_results: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if fold_results.empty:
        return fold_results.copy()

    ok = fold_results.loc[fold_results["status"].eq("ok")].copy()
    if ok.empty:
        return fold_results.copy()

    group_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "geography",
        "model_id",
        "label",
        "validation_id",
        "validation",
        "weighting",
        "outcome",
        "features_used",
        "categorical_used",
        "features_dropped_for_validation",
    ]

    summaries = []
    for keys, part in ok.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        weights = part["fold_weight_sum"].to_numpy()
        summaries.append(
            {
                **dict(zip(group_cols, keys)),
                "n_folds": int(part["fold"].nunique()),
                "n_zones": int(part["fold_n"].sum()),
                "r2_mean": float(np.average(part["r2"], weights=weights)),
                "rmse_pp": float(np.average(part["rmse_pp"], weights=weights)),
                "mae_pp": float(np.average(part["mae_pp"], weights=weights)),
                "status": "ok",
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(summaries)

print("helpers ready")
```

# 8.4) Lectura preliminar del baseline

La primera corrida de baselines deja una conclusion acotada: el baseline tiene
senal, pero todavia no alcanza como modelo final. Con zonas pesando igual, el
mejor modelo base llega a un `R2` cercano a 0.11--0.12 en ambas geografias. Esto
indica que QR inicial, soporte/volumen y macrozona capturan parte de la
estructura, pero dejan mucho crecimiento relativo sin explicar.

El salto mas claro del baseline aparece al agregar macrozona. En validacion
interna por zonas, pasar de QR inicial mas soporte/volumen a esa misma
especificacion con macrozona mejora el desempeno en residencia y origen de
viaje. La estructura territorial gruesa no funciona solo como control
secundario, sino como parte central de la senal descriptiva.

La lectura cambia al ponderar por soporte. En origen de viaje, el modelo base
ponderado por soporte alcanza un desempeno bastante mayor que el modelo con
zonas pesando igual; en residencia la mejora existe, pero es menor. Esto sugiere
que el crecimiento QR es mas predecible en zonas con mayor volumen observado y
menos ruido muestral, especialmente cuando se modela la geografia de origen de
viaje.

El stress test `GroupKFold` por macrozona queda debil o negativo. Esta caida no
debe interpretarse automaticamente como falla del modelo, sino como evidencia de
que la senal no transfiere limpiamente entre macrozonas. Parte importante del
fenomeno parece estar estructurada territorialmente.

El siguiente paso queda justificado: probar si las familias candidatas agregan
informacion sobre este baseline, en particular variables operacionales para
origen de viaje y variables socioeconomicas/urbanas para residencia.

# 9.1) Construir especificaciones de modelos por familias

Para que la comparacion sea limpia, el bloque `base` usado en estos modelos es
el mismo baseline descriptivo de `M3`: QR inicial, soporte/volumen log y
macrozona. Otras variantes de base, como usar volumen 2024 para prediccion
estricta, quedan para sensibilidad posterior.

```{python}
#| label: block6b-build-family-model-specs
print("label: block6b-build-family-model-specs")

FAMILY_BASE_FEATURES_DESCRIPTIVE = [
    "qr_share_2024",
    "support_min_log",
    "n_2025_log",
    "macrozone_group",
]


def parse_family_expression(family_expression: str) -> list[str]:
    return [
        part.strip()
        for part in family_expression.split("+")
        if part.strip()
    ]


def dedupe_preserve_order(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for value in values:
        if value in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(value)
        out.append(value)
    return out


def features_for_family_expression(family_expression: str) -> list[str]:
    features = []
    for family in parse_family_expression(family_expression):
        if family == "base":
            features.extend(FAMILY_BASE_FEATURES_DESCRIPTIVE)
            continue
        if family not in FEATURE_FAMILIES:
            raise KeyError(f"Familia no reconocida: {family}")
        features.extend(FEATURE_FAMILIES[family])
    return dedupe_preserve_order(features)


def build_family_model_specs(contract: pd.DataFrame) -> list[dict]:
    specs = []
    for _, row in contract.iterrows():
        features = features_for_family_expression(row["families"])
        categorical = [col for col in ["macrozone_group"] if col in features]
        specs.append(
            {
                "model_id": row["model_id"],
                "label": row["families"],
                "geography_key": row["geography_key"],
                "features": features,
                "categorical": categorical,
                "estimator": "LinearRegression",
                "pregunta": row["pregunta"],
            }
        )
    return specs


FAMILY_MODEL_SPECS = build_family_model_specs(family_model_contract)

family_model_specs_display = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "geography_key": spec["geography_key"],
            "model_id": spec["model_id"],
            "label": spec["label"],
            "n_features": len(spec["features"]),
            "categorical": spec["categorical"],
            "pregunta": spec["pregunta"],
        }
        for spec in FAMILY_MODEL_SPECS
    ]
)

display(family_model_specs_display)
```

# 9.2) Ejecutar modelos por familias

La lectura principal es incremental: cada modelo se compara contra `R1_base` u
`O1_base` dentro de la misma geografia, validacion y ponderacion.

```{python}
#| label: block6c-run-family-models
print("label: block6c-run-family-models")

def add_delta_vs_base(
    summary: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    base_reference: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if summary.empty:
        return summary.copy()

    base_model_by_geography = {
        "residence": "R1_base",
        "origin_trip": "O1_base",
    }

    out = summary.copy()
    out["base_model_id"] = out["geography_key"].map(base_model_by_geography)
    reference = out if base_reference is None else base_reference.copy()
    reference["base_model_id"] = reference["geography_key"].map(base_model_by_geography)

    base_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "validation_id",
        "weighting",
        "outcome",
        "model_id",
        "r2_mean",
        "rmse_pp",
        "mae_pp",
    ]
    base = reference.loc[
        reference["model_id"].eq(reference["base_model_id"]),
        base_cols,
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "model_id": "base_model_id",
            "r2_mean": "base_r2_mean",
            "rmse_pp": "base_rmse_pp",
            "mae_pp": "base_mae_pp",
        }
    )

    out = out.merge(
        base,
        on=["geography_key", "validation_id", "weighting", "outcome", "base_model_id"],
        how="left",
    )
    out["delta_r2_vs_base"] = out["r2_mean"] - out["base_r2_mean"]
    out["delta_rmse_pp_vs_base"] = out["base_rmse_pp"] - out["rmse_pp"]
    out["delta_mae_pp_vs_base"] = out["base_mae_pp"] - out["mae_pp"]
    return out


family_fold_results = []

for spec in FAMILY_MODEL_SPECS:
    geography_key = spec["geography_key"]
    data = analysis_datasets.get(geography_key, {}).get("data", pd.DataFrame())
    if data.empty:
        print(f"{geography_key}: sin datos; se omite {spec['model_id']}.")
        continue

    for validation_plan in BASELINE_VALIDATION_PLAN:
        result = evaluate_model_cv(
            data,
            spec,
            validation_plan,
            geography_key=geography_key,
        )
        if not result.empty:
            family_fold_results.append(result)

family_fold_results = (
    pd.concat(family_fold_results, ignore_index=True)
    if family_fold_results
    else pd.DataFrame()
)
family_summary = add_delta_vs_base(summarize_cv_results(family_fold_results))

FAMILY_FOLD_RESULTS_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "family_model_fold_results.csv"
FAMILY_SUMMARY_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "family_model_summary.csv"

if not family_fold_results.empty:
    family_fold_results.to_csv(FAMILY_FOLD_RESULTS_PATH, index=False)
if not family_summary.empty:
    family_summary.to_csv(FAMILY_SUMMARY_PATH, index=False)

family_display_cols = [
    "geography",
    "model_id",
    "label",
    "validation",
    "weighting",
    "n_zones",
    "n_folds",
    "r2_mean",
    "delta_r2_vs_base",
    "rmse_pp",
    "delta_rmse_pp_vs_base",
    "mae_pp",
    "features_dropped_for_validation",
]

if family_summary.empty:
    display(family_summary)
else:
    family_display = family_summary[family_display_cols].copy()
    for col in ["r2_mean", "delta_r2_vs_base", "rmse_pp", "delta_rmse_pp_vs_base", "mae_pp"]:
        family_display[col] = family_display[col].round(3)
    display(
        family_display.sort_values(
            ["geography", "validation", "model_id"],
            ascending=[True, True, True],
        )

    print(f"saved: {FAMILY_SUMMARY_PATH}")
```

```{python}
def build_regularized_family_specs(
    family_specs: list[dict],
    estimators: list[str],
) -> list[dict]:
    specs = []
    for family_spec in family_specs:
        if family_spec["model_id"] in ["R1_base", "O1_base"]:
            continue
        for estimator_name in estimators:
            spec = family_spec.copy()

            spec["model_id"] = f"{family_spec['model_id']}__{estimator_name}"
            spec["label"] = f"{family_spec['label']} | {estimator_name}"

    return specs
```

# 10.2) Lectura preliminar de regularizacion

La regularizacion no cambia la lectura general de los modelos por familias. En
origen de viaje, agregar variables operacionales al baseline mejora solo de
forma marginal cuando cada zona pesa igual. En la validacion ponderada por
soporte, que es donde el baseline era mas fuerte, las especificaciones con
operacion quedan por debajo del modelo base. Al sumar OSM y acceso a carga BIP,
el desempeno tambien cae o no mejora de forma consistente.

En residencia aparece la senal regularizada mas clara, aunque sigue siendo
moderada. El bloque socioeconomico con `RidgeCV` mejora el modelo base cuando se
pondera por soporte y tambien mejora el stress test por macrozona, aunque en
este ultimo caso el `R2` sigue siendo negativo. Con zonas pesando igual, la
mejora socioeconomica practicamente desaparece.

Agregar OSM y variables de acceso fisico a carga BIP no mejora sobre el bloque
socioeconomico residencial. En esta especificacion, esas variables parecen
aportar mas ruido o redundancia que informacion predictiva estable.

El finding del bloque es que el bajo aporte de las familias candidatas no parece
ser solo un problema de colinealidad de OLS. `RidgeCV`, `LassoCV` y
`ElasticNetCV` recuperan a lo mas mejoras pequenas. Esto deja abierto un ultimo
chequeo predictivo no lineal: evaluar si hay interacciones o umbrales que los
modelos lineales no capturan, sin interpretar ese benchmark como evidencia
causal.

# 11) Benchmark predictivo

Solo despues de baselines e interpretables. La lectura debe ser: techo
predictivo y no explicacion causal.

Modelos candidatos:

- Random Forest Regressor;
- Gradient Boosting / XGBoost si queda disponible y justificado;
- comparacion contra Ridge/Elastic Net.

# 11.1) Ejecutar benchmark no lineal

El benchmark no lineal se usa como chequeo de techo predictivo. No se interpreta
como modelo causal ni como seleccion final de mecanismos. La primera version
corre `RandomForestRegressor` sobre las especificaciones completas de cada
geografia. `XGBoostRegressor` se intenta solo si la libreria esta disponible.

```{python}
#| label: block8b-run-nonlinear-benchmark
print("label: block8b-run-nonlinear-benchmark")

NONLINEAR_ESTIMATORS = ["RandomForestRegressor", "XGBoostRegressor"]
NONLINEAR_SOURCE_MODELS = {
    "residence": "R3_base_socio_osm_bip",
    "origin_trip": "O3_base_ops_osm_bip",
}


def build_nonlinear_specs(
    family_specs: list[dict],
    estimators: list[str],
) -> list[dict]:
    specs = []
    by_id = {spec["model_id"]: spec for spec in family_specs}
    for geography_key, source_model_id in NONLINEAR_SOURCE_MODELS.items():
        if source_model_id not in by_id:
            raise KeyError(f"No existe spec fuente: {source_model_id}")
        source_spec = by_id[source_model_id]
        for estimator_name in estimators:
            spec = source_spec.copy()
            spec["estimator"] = estimator_name
            spec["model_id"] = f"{source_model_id}__{estimator_name}"
            spec["label"] = f"{source_spec['label']} | {estimator_name}"
            specs.append(spec)
    return specs


NONLINEAR_MODEL_SPECS = build_nonlinear_specs(
    FAMILY_MODEL_SPECS,
    NONLINEAR_ESTIMATORS,
)

nonlinear_specs_display = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "geography_key": spec["geography_key"],
            "model_id": spec["model_id"],
            "estimator": spec["estimator"],
            "n_features": len(spec["features"]),
            "categorical": spec["categorical"],
        }
        for spec in NONLINEAR_MODEL_SPECS
    ]
)
display(nonlinear_specs_display)

nonlinear_fold_results = []

for spec in NONLINEAR_MODEL_SPECS:
    geography_key = spec["geography_key"]

    for validation_plan in BASELINE_VALIDATION_PLAN:

            )
            continue
        if not result.empty:
            nonlinear_fold_results.append(result)

nonlinear_fold_results = (
    pd.concat(nonlinear_fold_results, ignore_index=True)
    if nonlinear_fold_results
    else pd.DataFrame()
)
nonlinear_summary = add_delta_vs_base(

)
```

# 12) Audit de outcomes

Antes de seguir mejorando algoritmos o features, este bloque revisa si el
problema esta en la definicion del outcome. La pregunta es si el crecimiento QR
zonal se predice mejor como:

- cambio relativo en puntos porcentuales;
- cambio bruto en puntos porcentuales;
- cambio relativo suavizado para reducir ruido en zonas chicas;
- aporte volumetrico por cambio de share;
- clasificacion de zonas top 20% en crecimiento relativo.

La lectura principal de este bloque no es seleccionar automaticamente el mayor
`R2`, sino distinguir si la tesis debe modelar una tasa, un aporte agregado o un
ranking de zonas de alto crecimiento.

```{python}
#| label: block9a-outcome-audit-targets
print("label: block9a-outcome-audit-targets")

OUTCOME_SHRINKAGE_K = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT


def add_outcome_audit_targets(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df.empty:
        return df.copy()

    out = df.copy()
    support = pd.to_numeric(out["support_min"], errors="coerce").clip(lower=0)
    shrink_weight = support / (support + OUTCOME_SHRINKAGE_K)
    out["outcome_shrink_weight"] = shrink_weight

    if "delta_relative_pp" in out.columns:
        out["delta_relative_pp_shrunk_support"] = (
            shrink_weight * pd.to_numeric(out["delta_relative_pp"], errors="coerce")
        )

    if {"delta_pp", "global_delta_pp"}.issubset(out.columns):
        delta_pp = pd.to_numeric(out["delta_pp"], errors="coerce")
        global_delta = pd.to_numeric(out["global_delta_pp"], errors="coerce")
        out["delta_pp_shrunk_support"] = global_delta + shrink_weight * (delta_pp - global_delta)

    out["top20_delta_relative_pp"] = np.nan
    for geography_key, part in out.groupby("geography_key", dropna=False):
        mask = (
            out["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
            & out["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
            & out["delta_relative_pp"].notna()
        )
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            continue
        threshold = out.loc[mask, "delta_relative_pp"].quantile(0.80)
        out.loc[mask, "top20_delta_relative_pp"] = (
            out.loc[mask, "delta_relative_pp"].ge(threshold).astype(int)
        )
    return out


model_df = add_outcome_audit_targets(model_df)
```

## 12.1) Resumen de targets candidatos

```{python}
#| label: block9b-outcome-audit-target-summary
print("label: block9b-outcome-audit-target-summary")


def summarize_outcome_candidate(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    geography_key: str,
    outcome: str,
) -> dict:
    base = df.loc[
        df["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
        & df["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
        & df[outcome].notna()
    ].copy()
    values = pd.to_numeric(base[outcome], errors="coerce").dropna()
    if values.empty:
        return {
            "geography_key": geography_key,
            "geography": GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key),
            "outcome": outcome,
            "n_zones": 0,
        }

    corr_with_main = np.nan
    if outcome != "delta_relative_pp" and "delta_relative_pp" in base.columns:
        corr_with_main = values.corr(
            pd.to_numeric(base.loc[values.index, "delta_relative_pp"], errors="coerce"),
            method="spearman",
        )

    return {
        "geography_key": geography_key,
        "geography": GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key),
        "outcome": outcome,
        "n_zones": int(values.shape[0]),
        "mean": float(values.mean()),
        "std": float(values.std()),
        "p10": float(values.quantile(0.10)),
        "median": float(values.median()),
        "p90": float(values.quantile(0.90)),
        "share_positive": float(values.gt(0).mean()),
        "spearman_with_delta_relative_pp": corr_with_main,
    }


outcome_audit_target_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        summarize_outcome_candidate(
            model_df,
            geography_key=geography_key,
            outcome=spec["outcome"],
        )
        for geography_key in GEOGRAPHIES
        for spec in OUTCOME_AUDIT_CONTINUOUS + OUTCOME_AUDIT_BINARY
    ]
)
```

```{python}
def build_outcome_audit_regression_specs() -> list[dict]:
    specs = []
```

## 12.3) Clasificacion de zonas top 20% de crecimiento relativo

Si el outcome continuo es ruidoso, una pregunta alternativa es si el modelo
sirve para identificar zonas de mayor crecimiento relativo. Este bloque usa
`top20_delta_relative_pp` como target binario.

```{python}
#| label: block9d-run-top-growth-classification-audit
print("label: block9d-run-top-growth-classification-audit")

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, balanced_accuracy_score, roc_auc_score


def make_classifier_estimator(estimator_name: str):
    if estimator_name == "LogisticRegression":
        return LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, solver="lbfgs")
    if estimator_name == "RandomForestClassifier":
        return RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=500,
            max_depth=4,
            min_samples_leaf=20,
            max_features="sqrt",
            random_state=SEED,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )
    raise ValueError(f"Clasificador no soportado: {estimator_name}")


def make_classifier_pipeline(
    *,
    numeric_features: list[str],
    categorical_features: list[str],
    estimator_name: str,
) -> Pipeline:
    estimator = make_classifier_estimator(estimator_name)
    tree_estimators = {"RandomForestClassifier"}
    transformers = []
    if numeric_features:
        numeric_steps = [("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median"))]
        if estimator_name not in tree_estimators:
            numeric_steps.append(("scaler", StandardScaler()))
        transformers.append(("num", Pipeline(numeric_steps), numeric_features))
    if categorical_features:
        transformers.append(
            (
                "cat",
                Pipeline(
                    [
                        ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
                        ("onehot", make_one_hot_encoder()),
                    ]
                ),
                categorical_features,
            )
        )
    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers=transformers, remainder="drop")
    return Pipeline([("preprocessor", preprocessor), ("estimator", estimator)])


def precision_at_observed_positive_count(y_true: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray) -> float:
    k = int(np.sum(y_true == 1))
    if k <= 0:
        return np.nan
    order = np.argsort(-score)
    top_idx = order[:k]
    return float(np.mean(y_true[top_idx] == 1))


def evaluate_classifier_cv(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    spec: dict,
    validation_plan: dict,
    *,
    geography_key: str,
    outcome: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    model_data = data.loc[data[outcome].notna()].reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    feature_info = prepare_spec_features(model_data, spec, validation_plan)
    if feature_info["missing_features"]:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    y = model_data[outcome].astype(int).to_numpy()
    if np.unique(y).shape[0] < 2:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    X = model_data[feature_info["features"]].copy()
    sample_weight = normalized_sample_weight(model_data, validation_plan["weight_col"])
    pipeline = make_classifier_pipeline(
        numeric_features=feature_info["numeric_features"],
        categorical_features=feature_info["categorical_features"],
        estimator_name=spec["estimator"],
    )

    rows = []
    for fold_id, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
        iter_validation_splits(model_data, validation_plan),
        start=1,
    ):
        y_train = y[train_idx]
        y_test = y[test_idx]
        if np.unique(y_train).shape[0] < 2 or np.unique(y_test).shape[0] < 2:
            continue

        fitted = clone(pipeline)
        fit_kwargs = {}
        if sample_weight is not None:
            fit_kwargs["estimator__sample_weight"] = sample_weight[train_idx]
        fitted.fit(X.iloc[train_idx], y_train, **fit_kwargs)

        score = fitted.predict_proba(X.iloc[test_idx])[:, 1]
        y_pred = score >= 0.50
        test_weight = sample_weight[test_idx] if sample_weight is not None else None
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography_key": geography_key,
                "geography": GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key),
                "model_id": spec["model_id"],
                "label": spec["label"],
                "validation_id": validation_plan["validation_id"],
                "validation": validation_plan["validation"],
                "weighting": validation_plan["weighting"],
                "outcome": outcome,
                "fold": fold_id,
                "fold_n": len(test_idx),
                "fold_weight_sum": (
                    float(np.sum(test_weight)) if test_weight is not None else float(len(test_idx))
                ),
                "event_rate": float(np.average(y_test, weights=test_weight)),
                "roc_auc": roc_auc_score(y_test, score, sample_weight=test_weight),
                "average_precision": average_precision_score(
                    y_test,
                    score,
                    sample_weight=test_weight,
                ),
                "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred),
                "precision_at_observed_positive_count": precision_at_observed_positive_count(
                    y_test,
                    score,
                ),
                "features_used": ", ".join(feature_info["features"]),
                "features_dropped_for_validation": ", ".join(feature_info["dropped_for_validation"]),
                "status": "ok",
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def summarize_classifier_results(fold_results: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if fold_results.empty:
        return fold_results.copy()

    group_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "geography",
        "model_id",
        "label",
        "validation_id",
        "validation",
        "weighting",
        "outcome",
        "features_used",
        "features_dropped_for_validation",
    ]
    summaries = []
    for keys, part in fold_results.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        weights = part["fold_weight_sum"].to_numpy()
        summaries.append(
            {
                **dict(zip(group_cols, keys)),
                "n_folds": int(part["fold"].nunique()),
                "n_zones": int(part["fold_n"].sum()),
                "event_rate": float(np.average(part["event_rate"], weights=weights)),
                "roc_auc": float(np.average(part["roc_auc"], weights=weights)),
                "average_precision": float(np.average(part["average_precision"], weights=weights)),
                "balanced_accuracy": float(np.average(part["balanced_accuracy"], weights=weights)),
                "precision_at_observed_positive_count": float(
                    np.average(part["precision_at_observed_positive_count"], weights=weights)
                ),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(summaries)


def build_top_growth_classifier_specs() -> list[dict]:
    regression_specs = build_outcome_audit_regression_specs()
    selected = [
        spec
        for spec in regression_specs
        if spec["model_id"] in ["A1_base_linear", "A2_interpretable_linear", "A3_full_linear"]
    ]
    classifier_specs = []
    for spec in selected:
        for estimator_name in ["LogisticRegression", "RandomForestClassifier"]:
            out = spec.copy()
            out["model_id"] = spec["model_id"].replace("_linear", f"_{estimator_name}")
            out["label"] = f"{spec['label']} | {estimator_name}"
            out["estimator"] = estimator_name
            classifier_specs.append(out)
    return classifier_specs


TOP_GROWTH_CLASSIFIER_SPECS = build_top_growth_classifier_specs()

top_growth_fold_results = []
for spec in TOP_GROWTH_CLASSIFIER_SPECS:
    geography_key = spec["geography_key"]
    data = model_df.loc[
        model_df["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
        & model_df["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
    ].copy()
    for validation_plan in OUTCOME_AUDIT_VALIDATION_PLAN:
        result = evaluate_classifier_cv(
            data,
            spec,
            validation_plan,
            geography_key=geography_key,
            outcome="top20_delta_relative_pp",
        )
        if not result.empty:
            top_growth_fold_results.append(result)

top_growth_fold_results = (
    pd.concat(top_growth_fold_results, ignore_index=True)
    if top_growth_fold_results
    else pd.DataFrame()
)
top_growth_summary = summarize_classifier_results(top_growth_fold_results)

if not top_growth_summary.empty:
    base = top_growth_summary.loc[
        top_growth_summary["model_id"].str.contains("A1_base_"),
        [
            "geography_key",
            "validation_id",
            "weighting",
            "outcome",
            "model_id",
            "roc_auc",
            "average_precision",
            "precision_at_observed_positive_count",
        ],
    ].copy()
    base["base_estimator"] = base["model_id"].str.replace("A1_base_", "", regex=False)
    base = base.rename(
        columns={
            "roc_auc": "base_roc_auc",
            "average_precision": "base_average_precision",
            "precision_at_observed_positive_count": "base_precision_at_k",
        }
    ).drop(columns=["model_id"])
    top_growth_summary["base_estimator"] = (
        top_growth_summary["model_id"]
        .str.extract(r"_(LogisticRegression|RandomForestClassifier)$", expand=False)
    )
    top_growth_summary = top_growth_summary.merge(
        base,
        on=["geography_key", "validation_id", "weighting", "outcome", "base_estimator"],
        how="left",
    )
    top_growth_summary["delta_roc_auc_vs_base"] = (
        top_growth_summary["roc_auc"] - top_growth_summary["base_roc_auc"]
    )
    top_growth_summary["delta_ap_vs_base"] = (
        top_growth_summary["average_precision"] - top_growth_summary["base_average_precision"]
    )
    top_growth_summary["delta_precision_at_k_vs_base"] = (
        top_growth_summary["precision_at_observed_positive_count"]
        - top_growth_summary["base_precision_at_k"]
    )

TOP_GROWTH_FOLD_RESULTS_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "outcome_audit_top20_fold_results.csv"
TOP_GROWTH_SUMMARY_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "outcome_audit_top20_summary.csv"

if not top_growth_fold_results.empty:
    top_growth_fold_results.to_csv(TOP_GROWTH_FOLD_RESULTS_PATH, index=False)
if not top_growth_summary.empty:
    top_growth_summary.to_csv(TOP_GROWTH_SUMMARY_PATH, index=False)

top_growth_display_cols = [
    "geography",
    "model_id",
    "label",
    "validation",
    "weighting",
    "n_zones",
    "event_rate",
    "roc_auc",
    "delta_roc_auc_vs_base",
    "average_precision",
    "delta_ap_vs_base",
    "precision_at_observed_positive_count",
    "delta_precision_at_k_vs_base",
]

if top_growth_summary.empty:
    display(top_growth_summary)
else:
    top_growth_display = top_growth_summary[top_growth_display_cols].copy()
    for col in [
        "event_rate",
        "roc_auc",
        "delta_roc_auc_vs_base",
        "average_precision",
        "delta_ap_vs_base",
        "precision_at_observed_positive_count",
        "delta_precision_at_k_vs_base",
    ]:
        top_growth_display[col] = top_growth_display[col].round(3)
    display(
        top_growth_display.sort_values(
            ["geography", "validation", "model_id"],
            ascending=[True, True, True],
        )
    )
    print(f"saved: {TOP_GROWTH_SUMMARY_PATH}")
```

# 13) Audit de señal fina: residuos del baseline territorial

Este bloque cambia la pregunta. En vez de evaluar si un modelo explica todo el
crecimiento QR zonal, primero remueve la parte explicada por el baseline
territorial:

```text
QR inicial + soporte/volumen + macrozona
```

Luego analiza si las variables candidatas se asocian con el residuo. Esto ayuda
a distinguir senales finas de simples diferencias territoriales gruesas.

No se agregan interacciones manuales en esta etapa. Los modelos de arboles ya
capturan interacciones de forma flexible; si aqui no aparece senal residual
basica, complejizar con interacciones no seria una prioridad.

## 13.1) Construir residuos out-of-fold del baseline territorial

```{python}
#| label: block10b-build-territorial-baseline-residuals
print("label: block10b-build-territorial-baseline-residuals")


def predict_baseline_oof_residuals(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    spec: dict,
    validation_plan: dict,
    geography_key: str,
    outcome: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    model_data = data.loc[data[outcome].notna()].reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    feature_info = prepare_spec_features(model_data, spec, validation_plan)
    if feature_info["missing_features"]:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    y = pd.to_numeric(model_data[outcome], errors="coerce").to_numpy()
    X = model_data[feature_info["features"]].copy()
    sample_weight = normalized_sample_weight(model_data, validation_plan["weight_col"])
    pipeline = make_regression_pipeline(
        numeric_features=feature_info["numeric_features"],
        categorical_features=feature_info["categorical_features"],
        estimator_name=spec["estimator"],
    )

    rows = []
    for fold_id, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
        iter_validation_splits(model_data, validation_plan),
        start=1,
    ):
        fitted = clone(pipeline)
        fit_kwargs = {}
        if sample_weight is not None:
            fit_kwargs["estimator__sample_weight"] = sample_weight[train_idx]
        fitted.fit(X.iloc[train_idx], y[train_idx], **fit_kwargs)

        y_pred = fitted.predict(X.iloc[test_idx])
        part = model_data.iloc[test_idx].copy()
        part["geography_key"] = geography_key
        part["geography"] = GEOGRAPHY_LABELS.get(geography_key, geography_key)
        part["outcome"] = outcome
        part["validation_id"] = validation_plan["validation_id"]
        part["validation"] = validation_plan["validation"]
        part["weighting"] = validation_plan["weighting"]
        part["fold"] = fold_id
        part["baseline_prediction"] = y_pred
        part["baseline_residual"] = y[test_idx] - y_pred
        part["baseline_weight"] = sample_weight[test_idx] if sample_weight is not None else 1.0
        rows.append(part)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


fine_signal_residual_rows = []
for geography_key in GEOGRAPHIES:
    data = model_df.loc[
        model_df["geography_key"].eq(geography_key)
        & model_df["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
    ].copy()
    if data.empty:
        continue
    for outcome in FINE_SIGNAL_OUTCOMES:
        for validation_plan in FINE_SIGNAL_VALIDATION_PLAN:
            residuals = predict_baseline_oof_residuals(
                data,
                spec=FINE_SIGNAL_BASELINE_SPEC,
                validation_plan=validation_plan,
                geography_key=geography_key,
                outcome=outcome,
            )
            if not residuals.empty:
                fine_signal_residual_rows.append(residuals)

fine_signal_residuals = (
    pd.concat(fine_signal_residual_rows, ignore_index=True)
    if fine_signal_residual_rows
    else pd.DataFrame()
)


def summarize_baseline_residuals(residuals: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if residuals.empty:
        return residuals.copy()
    rows = []
    for keys, part in residuals.groupby(
        ["geography", "outcome", "validation", "weighting"],
        dropna=False,
    ):
        weights = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_weight"], errors="coerce").fillna(1.0).to_numpy()
        y_true = pd.to_numeric(part["delta_relative_pp" if keys[1] == "delta_relative_pp" else keys[1]], errors="coerce").to_numpy()
        y_pred = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_prediction"], errors="coerce").to_numpy()
        residual = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_residual"], errors="coerce").to_numpy()
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography": keys[0],
                "outcome": keys[1],
                "validation": keys[2],
                "weighting": keys[3],
                "n_zones": int(part.shape[0]),
                "baseline_r2_oof": r2_score(y_true, y_pred, sample_weight=weights),
                "baseline_rmse_oof": float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred, sample_weight=weights))),
                "baseline_mae_oof": mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred, sample_weight=weights),
                "residual_mean": float(np.average(residual, weights=weights)),
                "residual_std": float(np.sqrt(np.average((residual - np.average(residual, weights=weights)) ** 2, weights=weights))),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


fine_signal_residual_summary = summarize_baseline_residuals(fine_signal_residuals)

FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUALS_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "fine_signal_baseline_residuals.csv"
FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SUMMARY_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "fine_signal_baseline_residual_summary.csv"

if not fine_signal_residuals.empty:
    fine_signal_residuals.to_csv(FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUALS_PATH, index=False)
if not fine_signal_residual_summary.empty:
    fine_signal_residual_summary.to_csv(FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SUMMARY_PATH, index=False)

display(
    fine_signal_residual_summary.assign(
        baseline_r2_oof=lambda df: df["baseline_r2_oof"].round(3),
        baseline_rmse_oof=lambda df: df["baseline_rmse_oof"].round(3),
        baseline_mae_oof=lambda df: df["baseline_mae_oof"].round(3),
        residual_mean=lambda df: df["residual_mean"].round(3),
        residual_std=lambda df: df["residual_std"].round(3),
    )
)
print(f"saved: {FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SUMMARY_PATH}")
```

## 13.2) Screening de variables contra el residuo

Esta tabla no reestima un modelo final. Solo pregunta que variables mantienen
asociacion con el residuo out-of-fold del baseline territorial.

```{python}
#| label: block10c-residual-feature-screening
print("label: block10c-residual-feature-screening")


def weighted_corr(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series, weight: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = pd.DataFrame({"x": x, "y": y, "w": weight}).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    valid = valid.loc[valid["w"].gt(0)]
    if valid.shape[0] < 5:
        return np.nan
    w = valid["w"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    x_arr = valid["x"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    y_arr = valid["y"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    w = w / w.sum()
    x_centered = x_arr - np.sum(w * x_arr)
    y_centered = y_arr - np.sum(w * y_arr)
    denom = np.sqrt(np.sum(w * x_centered**2) * np.sum(w * y_centered**2))
    if denom == 0 or not np.isfinite(denom):
        return np.nan
    return float(np.sum(w * x_centered * y_centered) / denom)


def feature_family_lookup() -> dict:
    lookup = {}
    for family, features in FEATURE_FAMILIES.items():
        for feature in features:
            lookup[feature] = family
    return lookup


FEATURE_TO_FAMILY = feature_family_lookup()


def residual_candidate_features(geography_key: str) -> list[str]:
    if geography_key == "residence":
        families = ["residence_socio", "urban_osm", "bip_access"]
    elif geography_key == "origin_trip":
        families = ["origin_operations", "urban_osm", "bip_access"]
    else:
        return []
    return [
        feature
        for family in families
        for feature in FEATURE_FAMILIES[family]
        if feature in model_df.columns
    ]


def q5_q1_residual_gap(values: pd.Series, residual: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = pd.DataFrame({"x": values, "residual": residual}).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if valid["x"].nunique() < 5 or valid.shape[0] < 20:
        return np.nan
    rank = valid["x"].rank(method="first")
    quintile = pd.qcut(rank, 5, labels=False, duplicates="drop") + 1
    if quintile.nunique() < 5:
        return np.nan
    valid = valid.assign(quintile=quintile)
    return float(
        valid.loc[valid["quintile"].eq(5), "residual"].mean()
        - valid.loc[valid["quintile"].eq(1), "residual"].mean()
    )


def screen_residual_features(residuals: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if residuals.empty:
        return residuals.copy()

    rows = []
    group_cols = ["geography_key", "geography", "outcome", "validation_id", "validation", "weighting"]
    for keys, part in residuals.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        geography_key = keys[0]
        candidates = residual_candidate_features(geography_key)
        for feature in candidates:
            values = pd.to_numeric(part[feature], errors="coerce") if feature in part.columns else pd.Series(dtype=float)
            residual = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_residual"], errors="coerce")
            weight = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_weight"], errors="coerce").fillna(1.0)
            valid = pd.DataFrame({"x": values, "residual": residual, "weight": weight}).dropna()
            if valid.shape[0] < 20:
                continue
            spearman = valid["x"].corr(valid["residual"], method="spearman")
            pearson_weighted = weighted_corr(valid["x"], valid["residual"], valid["weight"])
            q_gap = q5_q1_residual_gap(valid["x"], valid["residual"])
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography_key": geography_key,
                    "geography": keys[1],
                    "outcome": keys[2],
                    "validation_id": keys[3],
                    "validation": keys[4],
                    "weighting": keys[5],
                    "feature": feature,
                    "family": FEATURE_TO_FAMILY.get(feature, "unknown"),
                    "n_zones_with_feature": int(valid.shape[0]),
                    "spearman_residual": spearman,
                    "weighted_pearson_residual": pearson_weighted,
                    "q5_q1_residual_gap": q_gap,
                    "abs_spearman_residual": abs(spearman) if pd.notna(spearman) else np.nan,
                    "abs_weighted_pearson_residual": abs(pearson_weighted) if pd.notna(pearson_weighted) else np.nan,
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


fine_signal_residual_screening = screen_residual_features(fine_signal_residuals)

FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "fine_signal_residual_feature_screening.csv"
if not fine_signal_residual_screening.empty:
    fine_signal_residual_screening.to_csv(FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH, index=False)

screening_display_cols = [
    "geography",
    "outcome",
    "validation",
    "weighting",
    "feature",
    "family",
    "n_zones_with_feature",
    "spearman_residual",
    "weighted_pearson_residual",
    "q5_q1_residual_gap",
]

if fine_signal_residual_screening.empty:
    display(fine_signal_residual_screening)
else:
    residual_screening_display = (
        fine_signal_residual_screening
        .sort_values(
            ["geography", "outcome", "validation", "abs_weighted_pearson_residual", "abs_spearman_residual"],
            ascending=[True, True, True, False, False],
        )
        .groupby(["geography", "outcome", "validation"], dropna=False)
        .head(8)
        [screening_display_cols]
        .copy()
    )
    for col in ["spearman_residual", "weighted_pearson_residual", "q5_q1_residual_gap"]:
        residual_screening_display[col] = residual_screening_display[col].round(3)
    display(residual_screening_display)
    print(f"saved: {FINE_SIGNAL_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH}")
```

# 14) Audit within/between macrozona

Este bloque separa cada variable candidata en dos componentes:

```text
variable_between_macrozone = promedio de la variable dentro de la macrozona
variable_within_macrozone  = variable - promedio de la variable dentro de la macrozona
```

La parte `between` captura diferencias gruesas entre macrozonas. La parte
`within` pregunta si, dentro de una misma macrozona, las zonas relativamente mas
altas en una variable tambien muestran mayor crecimiento QR residual.

```{python}
#| label: block11a-build-within-between-macrozone-features
print("label: block11a-build-within-between-macrozone-features")


def add_within_between_macrozone_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    features: list[str],
    *,
    group_col: str = "macrozone_group",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    if df.empty:
        return df.copy(), pd.DataFrame()
    if group_col not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"No existe columna de macrozona: {group_col}")

    out = df.copy()
    metadata_rows = []
    for feature in features:
        if feature not in out.columns:
            continue
        values = pd.to_numeric(out[feature], errors="coerce")
        group_mean = values.groupby(out[group_col]).transform("mean")
        between_col = f"{feature}__between_macrozone"
        within_col = f"{feature}__within_macrozone"
        out[between_col] = group_mean
        out[within_col] = values - group_mean
        metadata_rows.append(
            {
                "feature": feature,
                "within_feature": within_col,
                "between_feature": between_col,
                "family": FEATURE_TO_FAMILY.get(feature, "unknown") if "FEATURE_TO_FAMILY" in globals() else "unknown",
                "n_notna": int(values.notna().sum()),
                "n_macrozone_groups": int(out.loc[values.notna(), group_col].nunique()),
            }
        )
    return out, pd.DataFrame(metadata_rows)


WITHIN_BETWEEN_FEATURES = sorted(
    {
        feature
        for geography_key in GEOGRAPHIES
        for feature in residual_candidate_features(geography_key)
    }
)

model_df, within_between_feature_metadata = add_within_between_macrozone_features(
    model_df,
    WITHIN_BETWEEN_FEATURES,
)

WITHIN_BETWEEN_METADATA_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "within_between_macrozone_feature_metadata.csv"
if not within_between_feature_metadata.empty:
    within_between_feature_metadata.to_csv(WITHIN_BETWEEN_METADATA_PATH, index=False)

display(within_between_feature_metadata)
print(f"saved: {WITHIN_BETWEEN_METADATA_PATH}")
```

## 14.1) Screening residual raw vs within-macrozone

```{python}
#| label: block11b-within-macrozone-residual-screening
print("label: block11b-within-macrozone-residual-screening")


def attach_within_between_to_residuals(
    residuals: pd.DataFrame,
    source_df: pd.DataFrame,
    metadata: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if residuals.empty or metadata.empty:
        return residuals.copy()

    join_cols = ["zone_id", "geography_key"]
    feature_cols = []
    for _, row in metadata.iterrows():
        feature_cols.extend([row["feature"], row["within_feature"], row["between_feature"]])
    feature_cols = [col for col in dedupe_preserve_order(feature_cols) if col in source_df.columns]
    source = source_df[join_cols + feature_cols].drop_duplicates(join_cols)
    out = residuals.drop(columns=[col for col in feature_cols if col in residuals.columns], errors="ignore")
    return out.merge(source, on=join_cols, how="left")


def screen_within_between_residual_features(
    residuals: pd.DataFrame,
    metadata: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if residuals.empty or metadata.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    rows = []
    group_cols = ["geography_key", "geography", "outcome", "validation_id", "validation", "weighting"]
    for keys, part in residuals.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        geography_key = keys[0]
        allowed_features = set(residual_candidate_features(geography_key))
        meta_part = metadata.loc[metadata["feature"].isin(allowed_features)].copy()
        for _, row in meta_part.iterrows():
            residual = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_residual"], errors="coerce")
            weight = pd.to_numeric(part["baseline_weight"], errors="coerce").fillna(1.0)
            for component, feature_col in [
                ("raw", row["feature"]),
                ("within_macrozone", row["within_feature"]),
                ("between_macrozone", row["between_feature"]),
            ]:
                if feature_col not in part.columns:
                    continue
                values = pd.to_numeric(part[feature_col], errors="coerce")
                valid = pd.DataFrame({"x": values, "residual": residual, "weight": weight}).dropna()
                if valid.shape[0] < 20 or valid["x"].nunique() < 2:
                    continue
                spearman = valid["x"].corr(valid["residual"], method="spearman")
                pearson_weighted = weighted_corr(valid["x"], valid["residual"], valid["weight"])
                q_gap = q5_q1_residual_gap(valid["x"], valid["residual"]) if component != "between_macrozone" else np.nan
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "geography_key": geography_key,
                        "geography": keys[1],
                        "outcome": keys[2],
                        "validation_id": keys[3],
                        "validation": keys[4],
                        "weighting": keys[5],
                        "feature": row["feature"],
                        "component": component,
                        "feature_col": feature_col,
                        "family": row["family"],
                        "n_zones_with_feature": int(valid.shape[0]),
                        "spearman_residual": spearman,
                        "weighted_pearson_residual": pearson_weighted,
                        "q5_q1_residual_gap": q_gap,
                        "abs_spearman_residual": abs(spearman) if pd.notna(spearman) else np.nan,
                        "abs_weighted_pearson_residual": abs(pearson_weighted) if pd.notna(pearson_weighted) else np.nan,
                    }
                )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


if "fine_signal_residuals" not in globals() or fine_signal_residuals.empty:
    print("Primero ejecutar block10b-build-territorial-baseline-residuals.")
    within_between_residual_screening = pd.DataFrame()
else:
    fine_signal_residuals_within_between = attach_within_between_to_residuals(
        fine_signal_residuals,
        model_df,
        within_between_feature_metadata,
    )
    within_between_residual_screening = screen_within_between_residual_features(
        fine_signal_residuals_within_between,
        within_between_feature_metadata,
    )

WITHIN_BETWEEN_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH = RESULTS_DIR / "within_between_macrozone_residual_screening.csv"
if not within_between_residual_screening.empty:
    within_between_residual_screening.to_csv(WITHIN_BETWEEN_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH, index=False)

if within_between_residual_screening.empty:
    display(within_between_residual_screening)
else:
    raw_within_comparison = (
        within_between_residual_screening
        .loc[within_between_residual_screening["component"].isin(["raw", "within_macrozone"])]
        .pivot_table(
            index=["geography", "outcome", "validation", "weighting", "feature", "family"],
            columns="component",
            values=["spearman_residual", "weighted_pearson_residual", "q5_q1_residual_gap"],
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    raw_within_comparison.columns = [
        "_".join([str(part) for part in col if str(part)])
        if isinstance(col, tuple)
        else col
        for col in raw_within_comparison.columns
    ]
    raw_within_comparison["abs_within_weighted"] = raw_within_comparison[
        "weighted_pearson_residual_within_macrozone"
    ].abs()
    raw_within_comparison["abs_raw_weighted"] = raw_within_comparison[
        "weighted_pearson_residual_raw"
    ].abs()
    raw_within_comparison["within_minus_raw_abs_weighted"] = (
        raw_within_comparison["abs_within_weighted"]
        - raw_within_comparison["abs_raw_weighted"]
    )

    display_cols = [
        "geography",
        "outcome",
        "validation",
        "weighting",
        "feature",
        "family",
        "spearman_residual_raw",
        "spearman_residual_within_macrozone",
        "weighted_pearson_residual_raw",
        "weighted_pearson_residual_within_macrozone",
        "q5_q1_residual_gap_raw",
        "q5_q1_residual_gap_within_macrozone",
        "within_minus_raw_abs_weighted",
    ]

    within_display = (
        raw_within_comparison
        .sort_values(
            ["geography", "outcome", "validation", "abs_within_weighted", "abs_raw_weighted"],
            ascending=[True, True, True, False, False],
        )
        .groupby(["geography", "outcome", "validation"], dropna=False)
        .head(8)
        [display_cols]
        .copy()
    )
    for col in display_cols:
        if col not in ["geography", "outcome", "validation", "weighting", "feature", "family"]:
            within_display[col] = within_display[col].round(3)
    display(within_display)
    print(f"saved: {WITHIN_BETWEEN_RESIDUAL_SCREENING_PATH}")
```

**Lectura del bloque.** Al separar las variables candidatas entre diferencias
gruesas de macrozona y diferencias dentro de macrozona, no aparece una senal
fina fuerte que explique los residuos del baseline territorial. En origen de
viaje, la oferta bus mantiene la senal residual mas consistente, aunque de
magnitud moderada. En residencia, las senales residuales apuntan mas a
composicion etaria que a educacion o centralidad urbana. El acceso fisico a
carga BIP sigue funcionando como control de baja senal. En conjunto, este audit
sugiere que el modelo zonal actual captura mejor estructura territorial,
soporte y volumen que mecanismos locales finos con las variables disponibles.

El modelo recomendado no necesariamente sera el que maximice R2. Debe cumplir:

3. interpretabilidad;
4. baja dependencia de variables redundantes;

# 19) Factibilidad panel zona-semana

Antes de reformular el modelo zonal, este bloque verifica si los datos ya
permiten pasar de una unica diferencia interanual por zona a un panel semanal
comparable. La unidad tentativa es:

```text
zona ZONA777 x semana comparable
```

con pares `W14`, `W15`, `W16` y `W17`, comparando 2025 contra 2024 dentro de la
misma semana ISO. Esto no reemplaza el modelo actual; evalua si hay suficiente
soporte, cobertura y estabilidad temporal para justificar una segunda
especificacion.
