## 19.2) Construccion del panel zona-semana

Esta celda agrega primero por semana para evitar materializar todos los viajes
como una sola tabla. Puede tardar, porque procesa ocho parquets grandes.

```{python}
#| label: block19b-build-zone-week-panel
print("label: block19b-build-zone-week-panel")


def collect_streaming(lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    try:
        return lf.collect(engine="streaming")
    except TypeError:
        try:
            return lf.collect(streaming=True)
        except TypeError:
            return lf.collect()


def parse_week_label(week: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    year_text, week_pair = week.split("-")
    return int(year_text), week_pair


def validate_zone_week_inputs() -> None:
    missing_trip_weeks = [
        f"{week}: {path}"
        for week, path in TRIP_WEEK_PATHS.items()
        if not path.exists()
    ]
    if missing_trip_weeks:
        raise FileNotFoundError("Faltan parquets semanales: " + "; ".join(missing_trip_weeks))
    if not CARD_MATRIX_PATH.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(CARD_MATRIX_PATH)


def trip_week_lf(week: str) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    path = TRIP_WEEK_PATHS[week]
    year, week_pair = parse_week_label(week)
    schema_names = set(pl.scan_parquet(path).collect_schema().names())
    required = {"id_tarjeta", "zona_inicio_viaje", "is_qr"}
    missing = sorted(required - schema_names)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"{week} no contiene columnas requeridas: {missing}")
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(path)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("origin_zone_id"),
                pl.col("is_qr").cast(pl.Int8, strict=False).alias("is_qr_trip"),
                pl.lit(year).cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"),
                pl.lit(week_pair).alias("week_pair"),
                pl.lit(week).alias("partition"),
            ]
        )
    )


def origin_week_rates(week: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rates = (
        trip_week_lf(week)
        .filter(pl.col("origin_zone_id").is_not_null() & (pl.col("origin_zone_id") > 0))
        .group_by(["origin_zone_id", "year", "week_pair", "partition"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_obs"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").sum().alias("n_qr"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_qr") / pl.col("n_obs")).alias("qr_share"))
        .rename({"origin_zone_id": "zone_id"})
    )
    out = collect_streaming(rates).to_pandas()
    out["geography_key"] = "origin_trip"
    out["geography"] = "Origen de viaje"
    out["unit"] = "viajes iniciados en la zona-semana"
    return out


def residence_universe_lf() -> pl.LazyFrame:
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(CARD_MATRIX_PATH)
        .select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("zona_hogar").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null() & (pl.col("zone_id") > 0))
        .unique(subset=["id_tarjeta"], keep="first")
    )


def residence_week_rates(week: str, residence_lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    card_week = (
        trip_week_lf(week)
        .join(residence_lf, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .group_by(["id_tarjeta", "zone_id", "year", "week_pair", "partition"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_trips_week"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").first().alias("is_qr_week"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").n_unique().alias("n_payment_values"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("n_payment_values") == 1)
    )
    rates = (
        card_week
        .group_by(["zone_id", "year", "week_pair", "partition"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_obs"),
                pl.col("is_qr_week").sum().alias("n_qr"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_qr") / pl.col("n_obs")).alias("qr_share"))
    )
    out = collect_streaming(rates).to_pandas()
    out["geography_key"] = "residence"
    out["geography"] = "Residencia"
    out["unit"] = "tarjetas activas en zona hogar-semana"
    return out


def safe_logit_from_counts_np(n_success: pd.Series, n_total: pd.Series, alpha: float = 0.5) -> pd.Series:
    p = (n_success.astype(float) + alpha) / (n_total.astype(float) + 2 * alpha)
    p = p.clip(1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))


def build_week_pair_growth_panel(long_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    index_cols = ["geography_key", "geography", "unit", "zone_id", "week_pair"]
    wide = (
        long_df
        .pivot_table(
            index=index_cols,
            columns="year",
            values=["n_obs", "n_qr", "qr_share"],
            aggfunc="first",
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    wide.columns = [
        f"{metric}_{year}" if str(year) else str(metric)
        for metric, year in wide.columns.to_flat_index()
    ]
    wide = wide.rename(
        columns={
            "geography_key_": "geography_key",
            "geography_": "geography",
            "unit_": "unit",
            "zone_id_": "zone_id",
            "week_pair_": "week_pair",
        }
    )
    for year in PANEL_YEARS:
        for col in [f"n_obs_{year}", f"n_qr_{year}"]:
            wide[col] = wide[col].fillna(0).astype("int64")
        share_col = f"qr_share_{year}"
        wide[share_col] = wide[share_col].where(wide[f"n_obs_{year}"] > 0)

    wide["support_min"] = wide[[f"n_obs_{year}" for year in PANEL_YEARS]].min(axis=1)
    wide["delta_pp"] = (wide["qr_share_2025"] - wide["qr_share_2024"]) * 100
    wide["qr_count_delta"] = wide["n_qr_2025"] - wide["n_qr_2024"]
    wide["total_count_delta"] = wide["n_obs_2025"] - wide["n_obs_2024"]
    wide["share_shift_qr_delta"] = (wide["qr_share_2025"] - wide["qr_share_2024"]) * wide["n_obs_2025"]
    wide["volume_qr_delta"] = wide["qr_share_2024"] * (wide["n_obs_2025"] - wide["n_obs_2024"])
    wide["logit_qr_share_2024_smooth"] = safe_logit_from_counts_np(wide["n_qr_2024"], wide["n_obs_2024"])
    wide["logit_qr_share_2025_smooth"] = safe_logit_from_counts_np(wide["n_qr_2025"], wide["n_obs_2025"])
    wide["delta_logit_qr_share_smooth"] = (
        wide["logit_qr_share_2025_smooth"] - wide["logit_qr_share_2024_smooth"]
    )

    group_cols = ["geography_key", "week_pair"]
    totals = (
        wide
        .groupby(group_cols, dropna=False)
        .agg(
            total_obs_2024=("n_obs_2024", "sum"),
            total_qr_2024=("n_qr_2024", "sum"),
            total_obs_2025=("n_obs_2025", "sum"),
            total_qr_2025=("n_qr_2025", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    totals["global_qr_share_2024"] = totals["total_qr_2024"] / totals["total_obs_2024"]
    totals["global_qr_share_2025"] = totals["total_qr_2025"] / totals["total_obs_2025"]
    totals["global_delta_pp"] = (
        totals["global_qr_share_2025"] - totals["global_qr_share_2024"]
    ) * 100

    wide = wide.merge(
        totals[
            [
                "geography_key",
                "week_pair",
                "global_qr_share_2024",
                "global_qr_share_2025",
                "global_delta_pp",
            ]
        ],
        on=["geography_key", "week_pair"],
        how="left",
        validate="many_to_one",
    )
    wide["delta_relative_pp"] = wide["delta_pp"] - wide["global_delta_pp"]
    wide["model_base_support"] = wide["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
    return wide.sort_values(["geography_key", "week_pair", "zone_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)


validate_zone_week_inputs()
residence_lf = residence_universe_lf()

long_parts = []
for week in PANEL_WEEKS:
    print(f"agregando origen {week}...")
    long_parts.append(origin_week_rates(week))
for week in PANEL_WEEKS:
    print(f"agregando residencia {week}...")
    long_parts.append(residence_week_rates(week, residence_lf))

zone_week_panel_long = pd.concat(long_parts, ignore_index=True)
zone_week_pair_growth_panel = build_week_pair_growth_panel(zone_week_panel_long)

ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_LONG_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_panel_long.parquet"
ZONE_WEEK_PAIR_GROWTH_PANEL_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_pair_growth_panel.parquet"
pl.from_pandas(zone_week_panel_long).write_parquet(ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_LONG_PATH)
pl.from_pandas(zone_week_pair_growth_panel).write_parquet(ZONE_WEEK_PAIR_GROWTH_PANEL_PATH)

print(f"long rows={zone_week_panel_long.shape[0]:,}")
print(f"paired rows={zone_week_pair_growth_panel.shape[0]:,}")
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_LONG_PATH}")
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_PAIR_GROWTH_PANEL_PATH}")
display(zone_week_pair_growth_panel.head(10))
```

## 19.3) Soporte, cobertura y consistencia del panel

```{python}
#| label: block19c-zone-week-panel-support-audit
print("label: block19c-zone-week-panel-support-audit")

if "zone_week_pair_growth_panel" not in globals():
    zone_week_pair_growth_panel = pl.read_parquet(ZONE_WEEK_PAIR_GROWTH_PANEL_PATH).to_pandas()

panel = zone_week_pair_growth_panel.copy()

support_summary_rows = []
for (geography, week_pair), part in panel.groupby(["geography", "week_pair"], dropna=False):
    supported_100 = part["support_min"].ge(100)
    supported_250 = part["support_min"].ge(250)
    supported_500 = part["support_min"].ge(500)
    support_summary_rows.append(
        {
            "geography": geography,
            "week_pair": week_pair,
            "n_zones": int(part.shape[0]),
            "zones_support_100": int(supported_100.sum()),
            "zones_support_250": int(supported_250.sum()),
            "zones_support_500": int(supported_500.sum()),
            "share_support_250": supported_250.mean(),
            "median_support_min": part["support_min"].median(),
            "p10_support_min": part["support_min"].quantile(0.10),
            "p90_support_min": part["support_min"].quantile(0.90),
            "global_qr_share_2024": part["global_qr_share_2024"].iloc[0],
            "global_qr_share_2025": part["global_qr_share_2025"].iloc[0],
            "global_delta_pp": part["global_delta_pp"].iloc[0],
        }
    )

zone_week_support_summary = pd.DataFrame(support_summary_rows)

zone_week_completeness = (
    panel.assign(supported_250=panel["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT))
    .groupby(["geography", "zone_id"], dropna=False)
    .agg(
        n_week_pairs=("week_pair", "nunique"),
        n_supported_pairs=("supported_250", "sum"),
        min_support_observed=("support_min", "min"),
        median_support_observed=("support_min", "median"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)
zone_week_completeness_summary = (
    zone_week_completeness
    .groupby("geography", dropna=False)
    .agg(
        n_zones=("zone_id", "nunique"),
        zones_all_4_pairs=("n_week_pairs", lambda s: int((s == len(PANEL_WEEK_PAIRS)).sum())),
        zones_all_4_supported_250=("n_supported_pairs", lambda s: int((s == len(PANEL_WEEK_PAIRS)).sum())),
        median_supported_pairs=("n_supported_pairs", "median"),
        p10_min_support=("min_support_observed", lambda s: s.quantile(0.10)),
        median_min_support=("min_support_observed", "median"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)

ZONE_WEEK_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_support_summary.csv"
ZONE_WEEK_COMPLETENESS_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_completeness.csv"
zone_week_support_summary.to_csv(ZONE_WEEK_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_PATH, index=False)
zone_week_completeness.to_csv(ZONE_WEEK_COMPLETENESS_PATH, index=False)

display(zone_week_support_summary.round(4))
display(zone_week_completeness_summary.round(2))
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_PATH}")
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_COMPLETENESS_PATH}")
```

## 19.4) Estabilidad temporal de la señal semanal

Este bloque mira si el cambio relativo por zona se parece entre semanas
comparables. Si la correlacion entre semanas es muy baja, el panel puede servir
para diagnostico, pero no necesariamente como modelo principal estable.

```{python}
#| label: block19d-zone-week-temporal-stability
print("label: block19d-zone-week-temporal-stability")

if "zone_week_pair_growth_panel" not in globals():
    zone_week_pair_growth_panel = pl.read_parquet(ZONE_WEEK_PAIR_GROWTH_PANEL_PATH).to_pandas()

panel_supported = zone_week_pair_growth_panel.loc[
    zone_week_pair_growth_panel["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT)
].copy()

stability_rows = []
top_persistence_rows = []
correlation_tables = {}

for geography, part in panel_supported.groupby("geography", dropna=False):
    pivot = part.pivot_table(
        index="zone_id",
        columns="week_pair",
        values="delta_relative_pp",
        aggfunc="first",
    )
    corr = pivot.corr(method="spearman")
    correlation_tables[geography] = corr
    off_diag = corr.where(~np.eye(corr.shape[0], dtype=bool)).stack().dropna()
    stability_rows.append(
        {
            "geography": geography,
            "n_zones_any_supported": int(pivot.shape[0]),
            "n_zones_all_pairs_supported": int(pivot.dropna().shape[0]),
            "mean_pairwise_spearman": off_diag.mean() if not off_diag.empty else np.nan,
            "median_pairwise_spearman": off_diag.median() if not off_diag.empty else np.nan,
            "min_pairwise_spearman": off_diag.min() if not off_diag.empty else np.nan,
            "max_pairwise_spearman": off_diag.max() if not off_diag.empty else np.nan,
        }
    )

    top_flags = []
    for week_pair, week_part in part.groupby("week_pair", dropna=False):
        threshold = week_part["delta_relative_pp"].quantile(0.80)
        top_flags.append(
            week_part.loc[:, ["zone_id", "week_pair", "delta_relative_pp"]]
            .assign(top20_week=week_part["delta_relative_pp"].ge(threshold))
        )
    top_df = pd.concat(top_flags, ignore_index=True)
    top_counts = (
        top_df
        .groupby("zone_id", dropna=False)
        .agg(
            n_supported_pairs=("week_pair", "nunique"),
            n_top20_pairs=("top20_week", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    top_persistence_rows.append(
        {
            "geography": geography,
            "zones_top_any_week": int(top_counts["n_top20_pairs"].ge(1).sum()),
            "zones_top_2plus_weeks": int(top_counts["n_top20_pairs"].ge(2).sum()),
            "zones_top_3plus_weeks": int(top_counts["n_top20_pairs"].ge(3).sum()),
            "zones_top_all_supported_weeks": int(
                (top_counts["n_top20_pairs"] == top_counts["n_supported_pairs"]).sum()
            ),
            "median_top20_pairs_among_top_any": top_counts.loc[
                top_counts["n_top20_pairs"].ge(1), "n_top20_pairs"
            ].median(),
        }
    )

zone_week_stability_summary = pd.DataFrame(stability_rows)
zone_week_top_persistence = pd.DataFrame(top_persistence_rows)

ZONE_WEEK_STABILITY_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_temporal_stability_summary.csv"
ZONE_WEEK_TOP_PERSISTENCE_PATH = ZONE_WEEK_PANEL_DIR / "zone_week_top_persistence_summary.csv"
zone_week_stability_summary.to_csv(ZONE_WEEK_STABILITY_PATH, index=False)
zone_week_top_persistence.to_csv(ZONE_WEEK_TOP_PERSISTENCE_PATH, index=False)

for geography, corr in correlation_tables.items():
    print(f"Correlacion Spearman entre semanas - {geography}")
    display(corr.round(3))

display(zone_week_stability_summary.round(3))
display(zone_week_top_persistence)
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_STABILITY_PATH}")
print(f"saved: {ZONE_WEEK_TOP_PERSISTENCE_PATH}")
```
